title: FunLearn
description: FunLearn is a prototype website for mock tutoring services which tutors children in Grades 1-12. It is a minimalist site which uses a simple professional style.

title: Memory Maze
description: Memory Maze is a vibrant browser game where you must memorize a maze quickly in order to traverse it without touching the walls.

title: Cat Mart
description: Cat Mart is an e-commerce application where users can browse and order cat-related products. It utilizes a simple design and adheres to Usability Heuristics.

title: Childcare Analytics
description: Childcare Analytics is a small dashboard showing annual childcare expense data in Canada. It focuses on simple presentation and interactivity.
